text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Both Trainer and <chrname> 
are training with such admirable fervor.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
In every era, 
the unwavering, steadfast resolve shared 
by humans and umamusume 
has carved out the path of history.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The unyielding light in both your eyes... 
calls to mind the very same spirit those 
legends possessed.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Your tireless devotion 
shall surely bear fruit before long.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Pray, continue to devote yourselves to 
your heart's content.

title: To Those Who Never Cease Moving Forward
